message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity (approx.) |
|----------|------|--------------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried lasagna noodles | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (beaten) | 1 |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup |

**Optional extras**

- Sautéed spinach or kale (about 2 cups)
- Sliced mushrooms (1 cup)
- Fresh basil leaves for garnish

Enjoy building your lasagna!
